review_policy.label_error_meaning: The scoped present/not_observed assessment is not supported by the supplied pseudo-C.
review_policy.evidence_error_meaning: The target finding does not expose the target-CWE relation needed to teach or justify the assessment.

decisions.notes: CWE-195 present target cites only inputBuffer NUL initialization; it exposes no signed-to-unsigned conversion or size use.
CWE-124 present target cites memmove(pwVar2,source,400) without the destination underwrite offset or boundary relation.
CWE-127 present target cites only printWLine(dest); it does not expose a buffer-underread offset or invalid read boundary.
CWE-122 present target cites allocation and writes to the source array, not the heap destination overflow operation.
CWE-127 present target again cites only printWLine(dest); the required underread relation is absent from the finding.
CWE-36 present target cites CR/LF stripping only; it does not expose path traversal, path resolution, or the file-open relation.
